summary_1line: Bhishma recounts a myth where the goddess Sri seeks to dwell among cows, who initially reject her due to her fickle nature.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant goddess Sri, glowing with beauty, steps into a quiet herd of cows who stare at her in astonishment.
The cows stand together refusing Sri, their calm forms contrasted with the goddess pleading before them.
Sri humbly begs the sacred cows to allow her to dwell even in the most humble part of their bodies.
